LANDED — Gerrit change 1642 merged as f487b62b3c on main (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1). Closed as class=preexisting: the capability map has never validated its own Epic-field answer, so this is an original gap in the mapping tool rather than a regression from a later change.

Note on the CI history: the first patchset took a Verified -1 from an infrastructure flake in the 'require resolvable rebar ticket' job ('server certificate verification failed ... could not fetch <sha> from promisor remote') — not a commit problem. recheck cleared it and the re-run went green with no code change.

Scope check for the record: no pre-create await_required_fields call site exists in scripts/jira_dc_capability_map.py after this change (two textual mentions remain, both prose explaining why the call is banned), and a test asserts that. 142 non-test lines changed.
